name: Question 17
problem:
The position $y(t),$ measured in meters, of a particle oscillating with forced harmonic motion without damping is governed by the equation

$$
{y}^{″}+4y=8{t}^{2},
$$

where $t>0$ is the time, in seconds. Given that the particle is initially at the origin with zero velocity, find the position of the particle after $1$ second.

Question 17
?

The position y(t), measured in meters, of a particle oscillating with forced harmonic motion without damping is governed by the equation

y″+4y=8t2,

where t>0 is the time, in seconds. Given that the particle is initially at the origin with zero velocity, find the position of the particle after 1 second.

a
 y(1)=(cos⁡1−2)m
b
 y(1)=(2cos⁡3+sin⁡3−1)m
c
 y(1)=(cos⁡2+1)m
d
 y(1)=(cos⁡1+sin⁡1+3)m
e
 y(1)=(sin⁡2+3)m
